Thanks for the draft and the clear asks. Quick answers from our side:

- Pen-test window: Late May works better for us. Two candidate windows: May 23-27 or June 6-10 (we can be flexible on the dates but prefer the May window).
- Evidence cadence: For scoped endpoints handling PHI we need monthly artifacts for the first two quarters after go-live, then quarterly thereafter. Non-PHI systems are fine on a quarterly cadence.

We’ll loop in our security ops folks if we need more technical details, but Megan and I can coordinate scheduling. Please send the redlines and we’ll review internally.

Sam —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. I attached a marked-up version of the security exhibit with our preferred contract language and a few suggested guardrails (security_exhibit_redlines_kiyer.docx). High-level callouts:

- Pen-test clause: We accept a customer-conducted pen test subject to reasonable rules of engagement. We propose a 2-week advance notice for scheduling, a mutually agreed test plan, and a single request for temporary escalation access (no standing access). We removed language that would allow unfettered live-production inspection without coordination.
- Audit rights / SOC2: We proposed a scoped evidence delivery schedule. For PHI-scoped systems, we’ve left the monthly artifact requirement but asked for sample sets (not full long-term logs) to protect customer privacy and limit data transfer.
- Evidence transfer: Recommend use of secured SFTP or scoped Drive links with expiration and Audit logging; we added an entry requiring hashed manifests (file lists + checksums) to validate transfer integrity.
- SLA/Timing: Suggested 10 business days for Redwood to respond to evidence requests; if a request requires engineering intervention we’ll propose an escalation path and estimate.

Can you confirm internally that the proposed 10 business day turnaround is workable for your stakeholders? Also tagging Irene to prep the evidence template and calendar placeholders.

Attachments: security_exhibit_redlines_kiyer.docx (docx)

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts

Thanks for confirming the windows and the artifact cadence. Summary of agreed items so we have one thread for the cross-functional team:

- Pen-test: Tentatively booked May 23-27 (customer-facing staging for run-through; prod follow-up if needed in June). Redwood will provide an engagement plan and rules of engagement by Mar 19.
- Evidence cadence: PHI-scoped systems = monthly for first two quarters, then quarterly; non-PHI = quarterly. We will use secure Drive links with expiration and manifest checksums for transfers.
- Contract redlines: Karthik’s redlines are attached; please confirm any terms that are must-haves for you by Mar 16 so we can finalize the exhibit.
- Turnaround: Redwood proposes 10 business days for standard evidence requests; if an engineering deployment is required we’ll use the escalation path (Irene will own the ops coordination).

Next steps:
- Sam/Megan: confirm any absolute no-go dates for the May window by EOD Mon 15th.
